title: One painting. Seven fragments.
asset_strategy: Lead with the painting as source truth, then move through scan/reconstruction evidence, then land on a wearable fragment with body proof. Use one quieter product/detail slide to keep the row breathable and premium. Keep text minimal, protocol-based, and archive-like.

slides.headline: ONE PAINTING.
slides.notes: Source image dominates. Bone background framing, severe crop, heavy negative space.

slides.headline: SCAN / ACTIVE
slides.notes: Treat as optical evidence. Technical label feel, close crop, no extra noise.

slides.headline: RECONSTRUCTED
slides.notes: Show the translation state. Sparse coordinates and scan marks, restrained red accent.

slides.headline: FRAGMENT 01
slides.notes: Use as a design-system bridge between art and garment. Keep it clean and proof-like.

slides.headline: WORN
slides.notes: On-body hero. Oversized silhouette, concrete/daylight, confidence, candid motion.

slides.headline: FRAGMENT 02
slides.notes: Quiet product surface for breathing room. Let texture and garment scale read clearly.

slides.headline: FOLLOW THE ARCHIVE
slides.notes: Close with a clean campaign endpoint. Fashion desirability first, concept second.

caption: Extracted from canvas. Reconstructed as wear. Follow the archive.
